name: Tottori

flag.description: A white emblem on a blue field: the hiragana と (to) drawn as a bird in flight.
flag.symbolism: と is the first sound of Tottori, whose name means "bird-catching"; the bird stands for freedom, peace and progress.

hook: Tottori means "bird catcher", and its white と (to) on blue is a bird; Tokushima's bird is yellow.
trivia: Tottori is the least populous prefecture.
In 2023 Tottori objected to a Hong Kong food company selling goods under a near-copy of its bird emblem.
